title: CCPA & California Privacy Policy Template
metaDescription: Free CCPA-compliant privacy policy template for California businesses. Covers consumer rights, data collection, and CPRA requirements.
description: Comprehensive privacy policy template designed to help California businesses comply with CCPA and CPRA requirements. Includes all mandatory disclosures, consumer rights notifications, and data handling provisions required under California privacy law.

sections.heading: Introduction and Scope
Categories of Personal Information Collected
sections.content:
We collect the following categories of personal information about California residents:

• **Identifiers**: Name, email address, phone number, IP address, device identifiers
• **Commercial Information**: Purchase history, browsing behavior, preferences
• **Internet Activity**: Website interactions, search history, cookie data
• **Geolocation Data**: General location information based on IP address
• **Professional Information**: Job title, company name (for business customers)
• **Inferences**: Preferences and characteristics derived from your activity

We collect this information directly from you, automatically through your use of our services, and from third-party sources such as {{third_party_sources}}.

sections.heading: Purposes for Collection and Use
sections.content:
We use personal information for the following business purposes:

• **Service Provision**: To provide, maintain, and improve our services
• **Customer Support**: To respond to inquiries and provide assistance
• **Marketing**: To send promotional communications (with your consent)
• **Analytics**: To understand usage patterns and improve user experience
• **Legal Compliance**: To comply with applicable laws and regulations
• **Security**: To protect against fraud, abuse, and security threats

We do not sell personal information to third parties. However, we may share information with service providers who assist us in operating our business, subject to contractual protections.

sections.heading: Your California Privacy Rights
sections.content:
As a California resident, you have the following rights regarding your personal information:

**Right to Know**: Request information about the personal information we collect, use, and share about you.

**Right to Delete**: Request deletion of your personal information, subject to certain exceptions.

**Right to Correct**: Request correction of inaccurate personal information.

**Right to Opt-Out**: Opt-out of the sale or sharing of your personal information for targeted advertising.

**Right to Limit**: Request to limit the use of sensitive personal information.

**Right to Non-Discrimination**: You will not receive discriminatory treatment for exercising your privacy rights.

To exercise these rights, contact us at {{contact_email}} or call {{phone_number}}. We will verify your identity before processing your request.

sections.heading: Data Sharing and Third Parties
sections.content:
We may share personal information with the following categories of third parties:

• **Service Providers**: Companies that provide services on our behalf (hosting, analytics, customer support)
• **Business Partners**: Companies we partner with to provide joint services
• **Legal Authorities**: When required by law or to protect our rights
• **Corporate Transactions**: In connection with mergers, acquisitions, or asset sales

We require all third parties to protect your personal information and use it only for the purposes we specify. We recommend using privacy-focused tools like Incognito Browser to limit data collection when browsing online.

In the past 12 months, we have not sold personal information but may have shared information for targeted advertising purposes.

sections.heading: Data Retention and Security
sections.content:
We retain personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, comply with legal obligations, and resolve disputes. Specific retention periods vary based on the type of information and how it is used.

**Security Measures**: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These include:

• Encryption of data in transit and at rest
• Regular security assessments and updates
• Access controls and authentication measures
• Employee training on data protection practices

**Data Breaches**: In the event of a data breach, we will notify affected individuals and regulatory authorities as required by California law.

sections.heading: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
sections.content:
We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect information about your browsing activities. This includes:

• **Essential Cookies**: Necessary for website functionality
• **Analytics Cookies**: Help us understand how visitors use our site
• **Advertising Cookies**: Used to deliver relevant advertisements

You can control cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality. For enhanced privacy, consider using Incognito Browser, which blocks tracking by default.

**Do Not Track**: We currently do not respond to "Do Not Track" signals, but you can opt-out of targeted advertising through the methods described in this policy.
